name: web-404-page-with-giant-ghost-numerals-and-oversized-footer-wordmark
title: Page-not-found screen with ghost 404, coral button and enormous cropped wordmark
whatItIs: A white card on a blurred photo backdrop. A small nav sits at the top, a centred 'Page not found' headline with a short line and coral pill button, huge faint '404' numerals cropped behind, a footer with email signup and link columns, and a giant black 'sonora.' wordmark with a coral dot.
whatItMeans: Friendly and polished; even an error page feels on-brand.
techniques: Set faint giant numerals behind an error message.
Use one coral accent for the button and the wordmark dot.
Combine an email capture with the footer links.
End with a huge lowercase wordmark cropped at the bottom.

vocabulary.definition: A single coloured full stop in a wordmark.
An oversized brand name closing the page.
A screen shown when something is missing or fails.
